Tip: to play a different wallet, switch the active account inside Phantom itself, then connect. Need a clean slate on this device? Visit /realm/?wipelocal — cloud-saved progress returns when you sign in.

title: ⚖ Trade pay restored — automatic restitution
body: A bug let a hidden safety cap swallow order-fill and sale payments for some traders — the goods moved, the $CHIKI didn't. Fixed, and the realm makes it right on its own: sign in and every payment the cap held back is re-credited automatically from your own sales receipts. Going forward the cap grows with your trade income, so a payment can never vanish again.

title: ⚡ FREE-PLAY EVENT — the gates close July 26!
body: For a limited time, Chikoria needs NO $CHIKI to enter. Sign in with your Phantom wallet — any balance, even zero — and walk in as the Wanderer with one chikimon egg to your name. Keep it warm, tend it in the Team tab, and it hatches your first companion. Every feature is yours: gather, craft, fish, battle, trade. And a permanent change ships with it: every egg now hatches ONLY its own kind — normal eggs hatch normals, legendary eggs hatch legendaries. No more lottery inside the shell. ⏳ The free gates close on JULY 26 — enter before then and your account, egg and progress stay yours forever.

title: 🥚 Fixed: vanishing eggs
body: A save-verification bug shipped with the Craft Orders update was wrongly flagging honest saves as tampered on every reload — and the anti-cheat's tamper response cleared nesting eggs, chests and the reward vault. The stamp is fixed, every save written during the bad window is recognized as legitimate again, and any wrongly-applied tamper mark is cleared automatically the next time you load. Real save-editing is still detected and punished exactly as before. If your egg vanished during the window, reach out — we can see affected accounts.

title: 🎮 Pocket Realm, rebuilt for thumbs
body: The mobile island got a full make-over: the castle, town walls, shops, streetlights, trees and resource models now render at 4-6x fewer blocks (your trainer, chikimon and other players stay full-detail), the cobblestone road smoothed into a clean plain road, and every label grew ~20% so nothing squints. The touch controls are now carved wood and gold like the rest of the realm — joystick low-left, E / JUMP / RUN in the open lower-right, clear of every panel and bar. And long trainer names now fit their nameplate banner perfectly.

title: 🌍 Fixed: PCs stuck at 82%
body: Some desktops — mostly touchscreen laptops or screens on high display scaling — were being mistaken for phones. They got the mobile game pack and a phone-sized engine thread pool, which stalled the load at exactly 82% and could crash the tab, or dropped you into the mobile version on a PC. Device detection is now exact: phones get the pocket build, every desktop and tablet gets the full build. If you were stuck at 82%, it was never your PC — try again.

title: 🔗 Choose your door: Wallet or Demo
body: The realm no longer assumes who you are. Every session now opens on a clear choice: CONNECT your Phantom wallet to load your real trainer, progress and $CHIKI — or PLAY DEMO to try the whole island first as the Wanderer with three random chikimon and a mount. The demo is a sealed sandbox: explore, gather, fish and battle everywhere, but nothing saves, nothing earns, no trading, and it never touches the live world — reload and connect whenever you're ready to make it real.

title: ⚡ The island learned to sleep
body: A deep performance pass, biggest on phones: the screen now renders at a sane pixel density on 3× retina displays (the UI was being painted at NINE times the pixels it needed), the ocean dropped to a fraction of its triangles on mobile, and the world finally sleeps when you're not looking — far fish schools, livestock, corruptimons and trees all pause simulation and drawing until you approach. The fixed sky no longer recomputes itself every frame either. Desktop looks identical; phones just breathe.

title: 📜 Ancient recipes + Craft Orders
body: Two big economy unlocks. ANCIENT RECIPES: the five sealed landmarks — the wicked temple, the raid altar, the crystal lode, the sunken galleon and the leviathan's cove — now each whisper a lost double-batch brewing recipe when you stand close and read their legend. Find all five and your cauldron yields 2× on those brews forever. CRAFT ORDERS: the Trading Post's new 📥 Orders tab lets you post what you NEED ("WTB 20 hide — 400 $CHIKI"). Your offer is escrowed on the spot; any trainer holding the goods taps Fill, hands them over and keeps 75%. Three open orders max, auto-refund after 25h.

title: 🔨 Crafting, refined
body: Brewing grew up: potions and food now craft ×5 or MAX in one tap (with a live 'can make N' count), every missing material tells you exactly WHERE to get it when you hover its red chip, and the artisan's secret is out — every craft has a 12% MASTERWORK chance that refunds half the materials. Gear ladders are untouched: each tier is still a one-off upgrade.

title: ⚡ Phones got a serious speed-up
body: Mobile now skips building what it never shows: the 168,000-blade grass field, the cloud layer, weather particles and the dynamic street-lamp lights simply don't exist on phones (lamps still glow at night). The world streams a tighter bubble around you. Your avatar, chikimon, and every building look exactly the same — the frame rate doesn't.

title: 🛡 Fairness & mobile hardening
body: A deep audit pass: one-tap Collect now banks BOTH purses (with the amount on the button and honest ceiling handling), phones always start on LOW graphics with a tighter world bubble, the touch joystick lives in its own bottom-left box, the reel duel is finally winnable by holding the Action button, joystick deflection cancels a gather, and the sideways mode survives every refresh. Plus a save-tampering hole was welded shut.

title: 🎣 The legends grew rarer
body: Fantasy fish are now 2× harder to hook across the board — Golden Chikifish 1-in-167, Crystal Koi 1-in-500, Mystic Eel 1-in-1429, Rainbow Fish 1-in-5000 base per cast (before your rod bonus and spot richness). Landing one MEANS something.

title: 🌟 Pocket Realm — mobile got HALF the weight
body: Phones now download a dedicated mobile-lite pack: half the bytes, a quarter of the texture memory — made for wallet browsers like Phantom. Desktop keeps full HD. Everyone also saves 50MB from a build-time cleanup, and the loader now survives connection hiccups with automatic retries.

title: 📜 System log + Update board + XP bar
body: The Chat box gained a SYSTEM tab — a timestamped history of every notification (XP, purchases, level-ups, hatches) so nothing vanishes with the toast. This very Update Board is now LIVE-fed each deploy. And your trainer level + XP progress sits under the logo, always on screen.

title: 🏃 Hold to run
body: Mouse-first movement grew up: quick-click walks you there; HOLD the button ~¼s and your avatar breaks into a RUN, steering after your cursor the whole time. Release and they finish the trip on their own.

title: 🌟 Sideways mode for wallet browsers
body: Phantom's in-app browser can't rotate — so now Chikoria rotates FOR you. Pick which way you'll turn your phone and the whole realm plays fullscreen landscape inside the portrait browser. Your choice is remembered; a tiny corner chip flips sides.

title: 🌍 Multiplayer rendering v2
body: Other trainers now stand on the TRUE ground (no more sinking), bring their whole 3-chikimon party trailing in formation at real size, and move with buttery MMO-grade motion smoothing. Far-off trainers cost nothing until you approach.

title: 📊 Smart collection pop-ups
body: Chikidex, Mountdex and Avatars gained live progress meters, Meme Dynasty scarcity bars (minted / cap), rarity glow on what you own, owned-first sorting, a 🎯 'next to finish' nudge — and the 3D viewer now compares any steed or chikimon against YOURS.

title: 🖼️ New collectible art for the whole roster
body: Every chikimon's NFT case has been repainted as a full scenic portrait — the creature standing in its own world, with real ground, contact shadow and matched light, instead of a figure on a plate. Forty species in all, and the ten normals finally have case art of their own rather than the generic sealed scroll. The same masters now serve the on-chain collection, so anything you have already minted shows the new portrait too.

title: 🃏 Painted battle cards for twenty chikimon
body: Twenty chikimon just had their whole hand painted — all twelve cards each, 240 in total. Every Meme Dynasty member and nine legendaries now play real illustrated cards in battle instead of falling back to their portrait, each one showing its cost, element, archetype, damage and its own flavour line. Galador also received his new collectible portrait, which completes the scenic set: every chikimon in the game now has one.

title: 🐎 Scenic portraits for every steed
body: All six mounts — Chiki Roost, Rumble Boar, Swamp Gator, Royal Steed, Dire Wolf and the Griffin — now have the same scenic collectible portrait the chikimon received, each one standing in a world of its own rather than posed on a plate. The set is complete: every creature and every steed in Chikoria now carries its own portrait.

title: 🏅 The Viranimal Legacy — six new chikimounts
body:
Six new chikimounts have joined the island, and every one of them was a real animal the internet met first. Emmanuel, the emu who could never let a camera film in peace. Momota, who wore a traffic cone like a crown. Pesto, the king penguin who outgrew both his parents. Snowball, the cockatoo who found the beat on his own. Tillman, who pushed off on a skateboard and held a record for it. And Wrinkle, who joined a marathon and kept going.

They are chikimounts like any other — you ride them, they live in your Stable, and they hatch from the same Chikimount Egg you already buy from Mithra. What makes them rare is that they run out: 50 editions across the six, and when the last one is claimed that steed is gone for good. Momota and Snowball are the scarcest things in Chikoria at five each.

The original six steeds go the other way: Chiki Roost, Rumble Boar, Swamp Gator, Royal Steed, Dire Wolf and the Griffin are now UNLIMITED — no supply cap at all — while keeping exactly the hatch odds they always had. Open the Mountdex and tap The Chikimount Legacy to read every story and watch each one turn in 3D.

title: 🐎 Every steed, bigger and true to its art
body: Every chikimount stood shorter than its own rider — so they grew, and then a few grew too far. The stable is now sized the way the animals actually are: a chicken and a duck stand level with you, the wolf and the boar above, the emu and the royal steed taller still, and the griffin over everything. The swamp gator stays low and long; Pesto stays flat on his belly. Their colours were rebuilt from the painted art pixel by pixel — the gator is deep olive again instead of grey, the dire wolf charcoal instead of near-white. Snowball has taken to the air with a real wingbeat, a hard downstroke and a folded recovery. And the collection cards now show each steed's painted portrait rather than a snapshot of its model.

title: 🐎 Steeds that stand still and walk properly
body: The chikimounts are back to the sizes they should always have been — the six original steeds exactly as they shipped, and the newcomers sized to sit beside them. Emmanuel and Momota were shuffling along on strides less than half the length of everyone else's; both now cover ground like the horse does. And Wrinkle and Snowball have finally stopped marching on the spot: a duck standing still now shifts her weight instead of walking nowhere.

title: 🐎 Ride like you're actually on the animal
body: Your trainer now moves with the steed instead of hovering above it — rise and fall with a galloping horse, sway with a waddling duck. Emmanuel's rider had been sitting on his flank rather than his back, which is fixed, and every chikimount now has a seat measured to the flattest part of its own spine. Snowball's flight is a gentle glide instead of a bounce, Momota finally rises and falls as it trots, and the strides that looked like shuffling now cover proper ground.

title: 🐎 Sit properly, face forward, ride bigger
body: Emmanuel was riding crabwise — his model is built turned, so the whole bird leaned right of where it was travelling. He now faces where he goes. The swamp gator's rider sat along its left flank and Snowball's had ended up on the tail feathers; both are seated on the spine now, and every steed's seat is measured from its own body rather than assumed. The dire wolf, royal steed and griffin have grown a third, the boar a tenth, and the chikimounts carry their painted portraits on the collection cards.

title: 🪑 Sit on the saddle, not the luggage
body: Riders were perching on whatever stood tallest on a steed's back — a bedroll, a saddle horn — which left them hovering above the boar, horse, wolf and Snowball. Everyone is seated on the actual deck now. Wrinkle has grown a third. Every family has its own emblem on its cards and its mint button, and opening a collection card now shows the creature turning in 3D, with its collectible artwork one tap away behind the NFT Artwork button.

title: 📐 Both docks, one shape
body: The right-hand pop-ups used to shrink to whatever they held, so opening your Avatar tab gave you a stub while the craft shop across the screen filled its whole panel. They now stand to the same height as the left-hand pops — the same band, from just under the clock down to just above the minibar.

title: 🗂️ One card, three pictures
body: Every collection grid — chikidex, mountdex, avatars and the stable — now shows the creature itself on a clean cutout, not its collectible art and not a snapshot of its model. Open a card and the model turns in a pop-up that is a third shorter than before, with its details laid out in two neat columns instead of a sentence wrapping into dead space. The collectible artwork is one button away, and the steeds' cards no longer carry another creature's stats alongside their own.
